entities.name: UUAA-MM procedure
entities.description: UAV Authorization and Authentication procedure performed by UE and AMF during registration procedure for UAS services.

entities.name: UUAA-SM procedure
entities.description: UAV Authorization and Authentication procedure performed by UE and SMF during PDU session establishment for UAS services.

entities.name: CAA-level UAV ID
entities.description: Identification parameter provided by UE supporting UAS services for authentication and authorization.

entities.name: USS address
entities.description: Address information provided by UE to enable network discovery of USS for UAS services.

entities.name: Service-level-AA container IE
entities.description: Container IE that includes UAS service parameters like CAA-level UAV ID and USS address, implemented as a non-cleartext IE.

entities.name: UE allowed for UAS services
entities.description: Condition where UE is authorized to access UAS services after successful UUAA procedure.

entities.name: Non-3GPP access restriction
entities.description: Condition where UUAA procedure is not performed and UAS services are not allowed over non-3GPP access.

entities.name: UAS connectivity established
entities.description: Property indicating successful establishment of connectivity for UAS services after UUAA procedure.

entities.name: Re-authentication procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by AMF or SMF for UAV re-authentication when required by USS.

entities.name: UUAA revoked
entities.description: Property indicating that UAV authorization has been revoked, requiring release of UAS-related PDU sessions.

relations.description: UUAA-MM procedure requires CAA-level UAV ID from UE.
UUAA-SM procedure requires CAA-level UAV ID from UE.
Service-level-AA container IE includes CAA-level UAV ID.
Service-level-AA container IE includes USS address.
Successful UUAA procedure establishes UAS connectivity.
Non-3GPP access restricts UUAA procedure execution.
Non-3GPP access restricts UUAA procedure execution.
UUAA revocation triggers PDU session release by SMF.
